architecture_contract.paper_method: Monae is described as modality-specific asymmetric teacher/student autoencoders with adaptive-clustering contrastive learning, a regulatory feature graph VAE, and feature-by-cell latent decoding; Monae-E adds cells as graph nodes.
architecture_contract.released_api_behavior: The exact tag exposes CoVELModel derived from the bundled GLUE/GLUETrainer implementation, modality-specific probabilistic encoders/decoders, a graph encoder/decoder, adversarial modality alignment, encode_data, encode_graph, and experimental decode_data.
architecture_contract.release_fidelity_finding: The inspected Python training surface contains no teacher/student modules, positive-sample branch, or contrastive-learning path matching the paper description. train.py instantiates CoVELModel. An optional DDC/classification loss exists only when configured cell-type labels create a classifier, while the official training scripts do not configure cell types. The exact release cannot be called a verified implementation of the paper-defined Monae until the authors clarify or provide a faithful immutable revision.

implementation.checkpoint_policy: No upstream checkpoint is admitted. If the fidelity gate is resolved, fit one local tensor-state bundle per outer donor fold and seed. Until then, no benchmark run may be labeled paper-defined Monae.
implementation.zenodo_warning: Zenodo v1.0.0 metadata labels the 157,679,969-byte archive CC-BY-4.0, while the GitHub root code is BSD-3-Clause and bundled src code carries a Gao Lab MIT notice. The archive, bundled data, and weights are not admitted; retain both source-code notices for any allowed derivative.

inductive_inference_contract.released_cell_transform: CoVELModel.encode_data can encode a held RNA AnnData in eval/no-grad mode and returns the posterior mean without target ATAC or query optimization, provided the exact training feature and representation contract is supplied.
inductive_inference_contract.released_cross_decode: CoVELModel.decode_data can call the frozen RNA encoder, frozen graph encoder, and target ATAC decoder without observed held ATAC or query fitting. The upstream method is explicitly marked experimental.
inductive_inference_contract.monae_e_exclusion: Monae-E X_init is learned by adding training cells to a graph and fitting PyTorch-BigGraph. No frozen raw-RNA transform for a new held cell is released. Monae-E is transductive and ineligible for donor-held or sealed queries.
inductive_inference_contract.raw_rna_requirement: The original notebook supplies X_pre copied from a preprocessed matrix. A future project adapter must start from raw held RNA counts and apply only training-frozen genes, per-cell total normalization/log1p, and training-fitted scaling to construct X_pre. No held-row fit is allowed.
inductive_inference_contract.status: Source APIs are technically inductive for the original X_pre lane, but no task is admitted until paper-code fidelity is resolved or the released implementation is explicitly renamed as a distinct comparator.

input_contract.atac_input: observed training ATAC counts over a GRCh38.p14 training-only peak inventory with a declared probabilistic decoder
input_contract.feature_graph: training-only gene-peak guidance graph aligned to GENCODE v49 and GRCh38.p14; the bundled GENCODE v42 annotation is not admissible
input_contract.original_monae_rna: raw UMI counts plus a project-created X_pre representation using outer-training-frozen preprocessing
input_contract.monae_e_rna: X_init graph entity embedding tied to the exact cells used in graph training; unavailable for frozen held-query use
input_contract.released_pairing_behavior: The CoVELModel training loaders treat modality cells independently and support unpaired modalities. Same-nucleus identity is not a released paired objective and must not be inferred from row order.

missingness_contract.released_training: Different modality cell sets are represented independently; no target zero padding is required.
missingness_contract.released_inference: RNA-only encode_data/decode_data accepts the source modality alone. Structural target absence remains explicit in the project manifest.
missingness_contract.project_mapping: Retain all eight project missingness states outside the release. Missing ATAC is never encoded as observed zeros.

output_contract.cell_embedding: released CoVELModel RNA posterior mean from encode_data; not yet admissible as a Monae paper representation
output_contract.released_atac_profile: With the official NB ATAC configuration and frozen target_libsize=1.0, decode_data returns a nonnegative decoder mean whose features sum to one, using target batch zero unless a training-known batch is explicitly supplied.
output_contract.profile_validity: The exact source release can technically emit a normalized held-RNA-to-ATAC peak profile without observed held ATAC or query fitting. It remains blocked from the benchmark because architecture identity is unresolved, the API is experimental, and the raw-X_pre and frozen-graph fixtures do not yet exist.
output_contract.target_batch_rule: Do not encode donor identity. Prefer no ATAC batch covariate; otherwise freeze one training reference category before evaluation.
output_contract.uncertainty: Use deterministic posterior and graph means for common prediction. Five separately trained seeds measure stability.

runtime_contract.dependency_status: README lists muon, simba_pbg, simba, scanpy, scglue, pytorch-ignite, typing_extensions, and tensorboardX without a complete immutable environment lock; two dependencies are installed from unpinned GitHub URLs.
runtime_contract.determinism_warning: The release states GPU scatter_add operations are not exactly repeatable even in repeatability mode; exact repeatability is claimed only on CPU.

safe_loading_contract.upstream_risk: Model.save and official notebooks use dill serialization/deserialization, which can execute arbitrary code. The repository also contains a 6,466,844-byte PBMC monae.dill object and links additional Baidu models.
safe_loading_contract.required_adapter: Never deserialize bundled or hosted dill. If a renamed release comparator is approved, reconstruct the audited architecture and restore project-controlled tensor state only, with graph, feature, transform, key/shape/dtype, fold, seed, and SHA-256 manifests.

source_evidence: The exact Monae v1.0.0 tag, immutable GitHub source, both code-license notices, official notebooks, Zenodo metadata, and primary paper were inspected on 2026-08-22. The official training surface and every direct src/*.py and top-level Python file were searched as text for the paper-described teacher/student and contrastive paths. No package, dependency, archive, checkpoint, weight, dataset, or serialized object was downloaded, installed, loaded, trained, or executed.

task_fit.cell_state_mapping: Deferred. The released CoVELModel has an inductive RNA posterior mean, but it cannot be benchmarked as paper-defined Monae until architecture fidelity is resolved or it is explicitly renamed as a release-code comparator.
task_fit.development_only_integration: Deferred for the same fidelity reason. Any future released-code comparator must report that it is unpaired CoVELModel behavior, not verified paper Monae.
task_fit.rna_conditioned_atac: Deferred. The released NB decoder can emit a valid nonnegative normalized profile without held ATAC, but paper-code identity, raw-X_pre transfer, graph freezing, safe loading, and runtime gates fail.
task_fit.variant_to_regulation: Ineligible because the release has no DNA sequence or allele-effect mechanism.
